events.title: NaiveAI opens a 309B sparse model with native 1M context
events.title_zh: NaiveAI 开源原生 1M 上下文的 309B 稀疏模型
events.summary: NaiveAI released Naive-N0.5-Flash under MIT: a 309B MoE with 15.5B active parameters and native 1M-token context. The model replaces full-attention layers with a mix of sliding-window and sparse attention and publishes weights plus inference code. Deployment requires FP8-capable NVIDIA hardware and roughly 315 GB just for weights; benchmarks are author-reported.
events.why_it_matters: For long-context coding and research systems, the architecture is a concrete test of sparse attention without full-attention layers. The high hardware requirement and vendor-only evidence make it a targeted infrastructure trial, not a default model choice.
events.summary_zh: NaiveAI 以 MIT 许可发布 Naive-N0.5-Flash：总参数 309B、激活 15.5B，原生上下文 1M token。模型用滑动窗口与稀疏注意力组合替代全注意力层，并公开权重和推理代码。部署要求支持 FP8 的 NVIDIA 硬件，仅权重约占 315 GB；基准仍由作者报告。
events.summary_en: NaiveAI released Naive-N0.5-Flash under MIT: a 309B MoE with 15.5B active parameters and native 1M-token context. The model replaces full-attention layers with a mix of sliding-window and sparse attention and publishes weights plus inference code. Deployment requires FP8-capable NVIDIA hardware and roughly 315 GB just for weights; benchmarks are author-reported.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对长上下文 coding 和研究系统来说，这个架构提供了完全不用全注意力层的稀疏注意力实测对象。硬件门槛高、证据主要来自厂商，因此只适合有对应基础设施的定向试验。
events.why_it_matters_en: For long-context coding and research systems, the architecture is a concrete test of sparse attention without full-attention layers. The high hardware requirement and vendor-only evidence make it a targeted infrastructure trial, not a default model choice.

technical_details.architecture: 309B MoE, 15.5B active; 39 SWA and 9 DSA layers
technical_details.availability: weights and inference code; no hosted inference provider
technical_details.hardware: FP8-capable NVIDIA GPUs; approximately 315 GB for weights

technical_details_zh.架构: 309B MoE、激活 15.5B；39 层 SWA + 9 层 DSA
technical_details_zh.可用性: 权重与推理代码；无托管推理入口
technical_details_zh.硬件: 支持 FP8 的 NVIDIA GPU；权重约 315 GB

events.next_action_zh: 一天内在 FP8 集群跑公开权重，测 128K/1M 上下文质量、首 token、吞吐、显存和输出一致性。
events.next_action_en: In one day on an FP8 cluster, test the public weights at 128K and 1M for quality, first token, throughput, memory and output parity.

evidence.claim_zh: NaiveAI 已公开 MIT 权重、推理代码、架构和训练说明。
evidence.claim_en: NaiveAI published MIT-licensed weights, inference code, architecture and training details.

changes.summary_zh: NaiveAI 开源 Naive-N0.5-Flash 权重与推理代码
changes.summary_en: NaiveAI opens Naive-N0.5-Flash weights and inference code
